column3: BSB adds “our” to “the fathers” and renders “in the prophets” as “through the prophets.”
BSB adds “But” and renders “the ages” as “the universe.”
BSB starts with “The Son” and makes two sentences; it follows the critical text without the Textus Receptus “by Himself” and “our” before “sins.”
BSB renders “today I have begotten You” as “today I have become Your Father.”
BSB renders “the scepter of uprightness” as “justice is the scepter.”
BSB follows the critical text with “like a garment they will be changed” (ἱμάτιον), which the Textus Receptus lacks.
BSB adds “the angels” and renders “for the sake of” as “to serve.”
